chunks: Have you seen him who restrains?

key_terms.أَرَأَيْتَ: Have you seen / Do you see

ai.seo_question: Who is the person referred to as 'him who restrains' in Surah Al-Alaq?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is frequently linked to the incident of the Prophet's prayer at the Kaaba, where Al-Walid ibn al-Mughirah attempted to physically restrain him from prostration. The verse highlights the arrogance of the Quraysh elite who sought to deter the Prophet from his divine duty, serving as a precursor to the revelation of 'Iqra' and the subsequent signs of prophethood.
